pyramiding_rule: Zero pyramiding into unconfirmed momentum vectors; new positions can only be added if the existing trade has secured at least +$10 in floating profit and moved past breakeven.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory order block and volume-delta confirmation on the M5 chart; no entry allowed within 15 minutes of high-impact tier-1 USD/XAU macro news releases.
profit_harvest_threshold: Aggressively trigger trailing stop activation or partial harvest once a position crosses +$15.00 floating profit to ensure wins securely hit the +$15 to +$30 band.
